title: Sunflower with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Stem -->
  <rect x='46' y='62' width='8' height='34' rx='3' fill='#3caa3c'/>
  <!-- Leaves -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='80' rx='13' ry='6' fill='#4dd14d' transform='rotate(-25 34 80)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='72' rx='13' ry='6' fill='#2f9a2f' transform='rotate(25 66 72)'/>
  <!-- Petals -->
  <g fill='#ffd21f'>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='10' rx='8' ry='14'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='10' rx='8' ry='14' transform='rotate(30 50 35)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='10' rx='8' ry='14' transform='rotate(60 50 35)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='10' rx='8' ry='14' transform='rotate(90 50 35)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='10' rx='8' ry='14' transform='rotate(120 50 35)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='10' rx='8' ry='14' transform='rotate(150 50 35)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='10' rx='8' ry='14' transform='rotate(180 50 35)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='10' rx='8' ry='14' transform='rotate(210 50 35)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='10' rx='8' ry='14' transform='rotate(240 50 35)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='10' rx='8' ry='14' transform='rotate(270 50 35)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='10' rx='8' ry='14' transform='rotate(300 50 35)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='10' rx='8' ry='14' transform='rotate(330 50 35)'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Petal highlights -->
  <g fill='#ffe873'>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='13' rx='4' ry='8'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='13' rx='4' ry='8' transform='rotate(60 50 35)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='13' rx='4' ry='8' transform='rotate(120 50 35)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='13' rx='4' ry='8' transform='rotate(180 50 35)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='13' rx='4' ry='8' transform='rotate(240 50 35)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='13' rx='4' ry='8' transform='rotate(300 50 35)'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Face center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='20' fill='#a8701c'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='20' fill='#bf8322'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='32' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#3a2205'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='32' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#3a2205'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='30.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffe873'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='30.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffe873'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M 40 40 Q 50 50 60 40' stroke='#3a2205' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='40' r='3' fill='#ff9c5b'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='40' r='3' fill='#ff9c5b'/>
</svg>
